rules.statement: A mortgagee who does not register their action under sections 27 (a) (1) of the Land Registration Ordinance, 1891, as amended by Ordinance No. 29 of 1917, loses their rights against a puisne incumbrancer.
rules.supporting_quote: "In order to protect the mortgagee there is provision in sections 643 and 644 for the registration of addresses, and I think it is now pretty well settled that a mortgagee, who does not avail himself of this protection, loses his rights against a puisne incumbrancer not joined in his mortgage action."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 27 (a) (1) of the Land Registration Ordinance, 1891, as amended by Ordinance No. 29 of 1917
